meta.title: AgentScope Platform
meta.description: AgentScope Platform inside DeepSeek Harness: manage several platform accounts (switch the billing account by hand, pick one by remaining Credits, probe and flag unhealthy ones), an optional OpenAI-compatible model provider whose catalog you can fetch, add to and edit row by row, an available-Credits and redeemable-contribution readout under the composer, and a settings panel for the daily check-in, the balance, contribution grants, usage detail and the price list. Switching accounts affects new requests only and never interrupts a session already in flight.
